description: Curated skill taxonomy for AI Job Assistant. Canonical names are globally unique. Aliases are matched with word-boundary protection. 'related' powers transferable-skill suggestions. 'learning_hints' power gap-analysis guidance. 'case_sensitive' is used for short ambiguous names such as Go, R and C.
